note: Vault definitions for the Sprint-12 soak drills. Deliberately DIFFERENT from the Sprint-9 smoke vault in basket, caps, fees and governance, so that drill 1's leaderboard aggregation is proving real cross-vault aggregation rather than summing two identical rows.
readingThisFile: On-chain sentences below are tagged with the date they were MEASURED, and nothing is tagged that was not read from Base Sepolia on that date. ONE BLOCK IS DELIBERATELY NOT TAGGED SENTENCE-BY-SENTENCE, so that this preamble is not a universal a reader can break in one pass: smokeVault.replaced keeps its original untagged 2026-09-03 prose verbatim and closes with a single dated re-measurement covering all four of the numbers it asserts. A previous version of the smokeVault note opened with a single date and then continued into observations taken on a different, earlier date, and a reader carried the opening date across the whole note. That ambiguity - not only the one number it hid - is the defect this convention closes. RPC rule, learned twice: base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com PRUNES LOGS AND RECEIPTS and must not be used for any eth_getLogs or eth_getTransactionReceipt read. Every dated read here was taken on TWO providers, https://sepolia.base.org and https://base-sepolia.drpc.org, and is recorded only where both agreed.
agentDepositNote: Drill 5: WHOLE USDC, not base units. policy.join.depositUsdc in the reference agent is denominated in dollars (its shipped default is "25"), unlike every other amount in this file. 1 = the smoke vault minimum of 1.00 USDC - (2026-09-10) minDepositUsdc() reads 1000000 on both providers. Passing base units here made the agent request a million-dollar deposit and its capacity gate correctly refused.

smokeVault.replaced: 0x97025d1c60a24ce3811dcb3be4529c5e1c6a6330 - the Sprint-9 vault, pinned here until 2026-09-03. It had to go for three independent reasons, each read on-chain rather than inferred: its oracle() is 0xEc1976579Af27b3dF5fd103390acAb22E4b566F4, the CUSTOM OracleAggregator that the C-6 pivot retired; isAllowedAdapter is FALSE for both the current adapter and the retired one, and isAllowedAdapter is constructor-only, so drill 2 could not have executed a rebalance through it at all; and its codesize is 23,016 B, from the generation BEFORE the deployment this file's address book describes. Its note also claimed 'Fully exited at the end of Sprint-9 (0 shares, 0 NAV)' while totalShares() read 4e18. That is the specific hazard worth naming: .json IS inside the claims guard's PUBLIC_EXT, but the guard matches claim SHAPES, and no shape can know that a number disagrees with a chain. Nothing re-derives this file - so re-read it against chain when the deployment changes. (2026-09-10) ALL FOUR of those numbers were re-measured on both providers and all four still hold: oracle() 0xEc1976579Af27b3dF5fd103390acAb22E4b566F4, isAllowedAdapter(0x68be942cab962ac8f9064b45489f35fbd6f617d5) false, isAllowedAdapter(0xf3e08c8b00281750d531a48473d053009038a9b1 - the retired adapter, full address recovered from commit 0f9356a3 of contracts/config/deployments/base-sepolia.json) false, codesize 23016, totalShares() 4000000000000000000.

vaultB.label: soak-B
vaultB.note: Drill 1's second vault and drill 3's Mode-F host. Basket is LINK-ONLY -- a strict subset of the smoke vault's basket, which makes it a different risk profile for the leaderboard AND keeps it eligible to be a child of the smoke vault should we need a second sub-vault case. Governance runs a 50% quorum against the smoke vault's 25% floor - (2026-09-10) Governance.configOf(smoke vault).quorumBps reads 2500 on both providers.

childVault.label: soak-child
childVault.note: Drill 2's sub-vault, created under the smoke vault. Basket [WETH] is a strict subset of the parent's [WETH, LINK] -- VaultFactory.createChildVault enforces the subset rule and the same USDC; (2026-09-10) the parent's usdc() reads 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e on both providers, which is the `infrastructure.usdc` of contracts/config/deployments/base-sepolia.json. exitFeeMaxBps must keep the SV-4 stacked ceiling under the registry cap: parent 50 + child 25 = 75 bps - (2026-09-10) the parent's exitFeeMaxBps() reads 50 and SubVaultRegistry.STACKED_EXIT_FEE_CAP_BPS() reads 250, both providers.
childVault.amountsNote: Drill 2 deposits 4 USDC into the PARENT and allocates 2 of it into the child, leaving 2 idle. Keeping some idle is deliberate: it proves the parent NAV conservation check is reading a real split rather than a total transfer, and it leaves room for the redeem round trip.
childVault.govNote: SV-6 / _requireParentQuorumFloor: a child's quorum may not sit below its parent's. Parent runs 2500, child runs 5000, so the floor is satisfied with margin. (2026-09-10) The parent's 2500 is Governance.configOf(0xb940d71b...3c98).quorumBps, read on both providers. A duplicate `allocateUsdc` key used to sit after this one; both copies held "2000000", JSON last-wins made them indistinguishable, and the trailing copy has been removed.

parentDeposit.note: Into the smoke vault, funding drill 2's allocation into the child (4 USDC) with idle USDC left over so the parent's own NAV stays non-zero and look-through arithmetic has two non-trivial terms to check.

budget.note: 13 of the creator's 20 USDC: 5 into vault B (drills 1+3) and 8 into the smoke vault (drill 2). 7 USDC held in reserve so a stranded drill can be re-run without a faucet round trip.
